messages.author: 600d8618914ec141
messages.subject: Vigorous activity minutes and mvpa
parts: Hi,  I would like to ask about the calculations of mvpa. Is 1 vigorous intensity activity minute equivalent to 2 moderate intensity activity minutes for the mvpa variables? For example, individual 1 has 10 minutes of vigorous intensity activity and 20 minutes of moderate intensity activity, does the calculated mvpa output show 40 minutes of mvpa?

messages.author: 5270e62a7d3ec577
messages.subject: Re: Vigorous activity minutes and mvpa
parts: Hello, the short answer to your question is no it does not, 10 minutes vig PA + 20 minutes moderate PA would still be 30 minutes. Time in MVPA is the sum time spent above the moderate and vigorous thresholds specified in your script (arguments "threshold.mod" and "threshold.vig" for part 5 analyses, or in "mvpathreshold" if just running up to part 2) . You do get these two separate time values so if you wanted to double the value of vigorous intensity for some reason you could do it post-hoc.
